title: Crypto sleeves meant to be UNCORRELATED with v8.6 (different horizon / driver), 3 trials

trials.A funding-settlement pressure: 20 pack coins; at every funding settlement T (00/08/16 UTC), using the PREVIOUS settlement's rate (known): short 0.1 if it was > 0.03%, long 0.1 if < -0.01%, held only during the hour bar before T (T-1h..T); 5 bp per side, no funding paid (flat at T)
trials.B residual reversal: 60-coin universe, daily: residual = 1-day return minus 60-day beta x BTC 1-day return; long the lowest third, short the highest third (inverse-vol legs), 3-day hold in 3 staggered tranches; 5 bp + funding
trials.C pump reversal: 60 coins hourly: an hour with return > +4 x the coin's trailing 720-hour sd (lagged) -> short 0.2 from that hour's close for 12 hours, at most 3 open; 5 bp per side + funding

bars: sleeve DEV (2020-22) > 0, TEST (2023-24) >= 0.8, HOLD (2025-26) >= 0.5 AND |daily correlation with the v8.6 portfolio 2020-26| <= 0.2 -> 'orthogonal candidate'; then also the strict rule for adding it to v8.6 (every period not lower, +0.05)
